Calculatrice scientifique : tape une exp: A scientific calculator: type a whole expression on the keyboard or click the keys, and the result shows live. Precedence and parentheses, powers, factorial, percent, trigonometry in degrees or radians, logarithms, roots, π, e, Ans and implicit multiplication (2π). The last 50 calculations stay in a history; click a result to reuse it.
